evals.prompt:
From these labelled reqs, produce a tagged Umple model and Java code.

req R01 { A person has a name. }
evals.expected_output: Uses requirements-tracer then code-generator: req/implementsReq plus a Java API call.
expectations: The agent follows or reads umple-requirements-tracer
The Umple source contains req R01 and implementsReq
The agent follows or reads umple-code-generator (or calls language=Java codegen)
The API is called with language=Java at least once
No invented extra requirement IDs beyond R01

evals.prompt: Draw a state model of a door Open/Closed, then add a main that toggles it.
evals.expected_output: Diagram/state Umple via diagram skill synonyms, then main-generator.
expectations: The agent treats 'state model' as a state machine (diagram-generator or equivalent)
The Umple source contains Open and Closed states
A main method is generated that fires events
No state named Final
The API was called at least once

evals.prompt: Here is a huge unlabelled hospital narrative with no IDs (billing, labs, rotas, …). Build a domain model only — do not invent implementsReq.
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator routes to modeling without requirements-tracer tagging.
expectations: The Umple source has no implementsReq
The agent does not invent a large req ID scheme
Domain classes such as Hospital/Patient/Ward (or similar) appear
Tim's unlabelled-dump rule is respected

evals.prompt: Create a Library product line: core always on; mixset Premium adds email on Member; activate Premium; validate.
expectations: A mixset Premium (or equivalent) exists with use
The agent mentions or runs validation/compile
Core Member/Library structure exists
The API was called with language=Java

evals.prompt: Generate a data model diagram for Student and Course many-to-many.
evals.expected_output: Routes to diagram-generator with class/data-model synonym.
expectations: The agent uses diagram-generator (classDiagram or equivalent)
Student and Course appear
Many-to-many association is defined once
language=classDiagram or diagramUpdate style is used if an API diagram call is made

evals.prompt: My Umple declares association A--B on both classes. Fix it, then generate a main.
expectations: Duplicate association is fixed (only one declaration remains)
A main method is added afterward
Validation/compile happens before claiming success
Retries do not exceed 3 for the fix loop

evals.prompt: End-to-end: labelled reqs for a Light on/off, tag implementsReq, add main that toggles, generate Java.
expectations: req and implementsReq appear for the light behaviour
A state machine or class Light exists
main fires on/off (or equivalent)
Java codegen API is called
The agent names or clearly uses multiple sibling skills

evals.prompt:
Only generate Python from this Umple — do not draw a diagram.

class Box { String label; }
evals.expected_output: Single-skill route to code-generator with Python.
expectations: The agent does not unnecessarily call diagram-generator
API language=Python is used
Box model is preserved
Orchestrator keeps the pipeline minimal

evals.prompt: Explain which Umple skills you would use for: (a) FSM diagram (b) implementsReq (c) mixsets — then do (b) only for req R1 { x }.
evals.expected_output: Correct routing explanation; only tracer executed for R1.
expectations: FSM diagram routed to diagram-generator in the explanation
implementsReq routed to requirements-tracer
mixsets routed to mixset-builder
Actual generation for R1 includes req/implementsReq and not an unrelated mixset

evals.prompt: Use as many Umple features as reasonable in one small teaching model: class, association, state machine, enum, then validate.
evals.expected_output: Compact model using several features; validator/compile at end.
expectations: The Umple source contains at least one class and one association
The Umple source contains a state machine or enum (or both)
Model stays relatively small (not hundreds of lines of noise)
A final compile/validate step is performed
One association per class pair; no Final state name
